verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              तस्यां सभायां दैत्येन्द्रो हिरण्यकशिपुः प्रभुः। आसीन आसने दिव्ये नत्वमात्रे प्रमाणतः॥१॥
दिवाकरनिभे रम्ये दिव्यास्तरणसम्भृते। रराज सुचिरं राजञ्ज्वलत्काञ्चनकुण्डलः॥२॥
verses.english: Clasping eight weapons in eight fists he glistened like an unswerving lofty mountaintop mounted on a skyscape florid with fused sunrays and moonbeams...

verses.sanskrit: तस्य दैत्यपतेर्मन्दं विरजस्कं समन्ततः। दिव्यगन्धवहस्तत्र मारुतः सुमुखो ववौ॥३॥
verses.english: Indeed he who pioneers all living beings - नर-अयन - is नारायण; he is unmanifest, yet self- manifest, allusively; he is the lord and god; eternal soul; unmodifiable entity and he assumed the form of श्रीअरि in the क्ऱित era; and when we verbalise as ब्रह्म, इन्द्र, सोम, धर्म, शुक्र or ब्ऱिहस्पति et al, they are all the other manifestations of this नारायण॥।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वा गणैरप्सरसां वृताः। दिव्यतालेन दिव्यानि जगुर्गीतानि गायनाः॥४॥
verses.english: विष्णु, the dynast of यादव-s, became the son of lady अदिति and became इन्द्र, the junior, इन्द्र-अवरज, in his वामन incarnation.., to accomplish the destruction of the enemies of the celestials, namely दैत्या-स्, दानवा-स् and राक्शसा-स्, that lord manifested himself as the son of lady अदिति, just to grace that lady, in his dwarf-boy incarnation...
verses.bhavadeepa: मन्दं विरजस्कं च यथा स्यात्तथा वै वा॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: विश्वाची सहजन्या च प्रम्लोचेत्यभिविश्रुता। दिव्या च सौरभेया च समीची पुञ्जिकस्थला॥५॥
verses.english: Then the gods headed by इन्द्र reverently enfolding their palms hailed him and sought refuge with the lord विष्णु to whom all resort for shelter...

verses.sanskrit: मिश्रकेशी च रम्मा च चित्रसेना शुचिस्मिता। चारुनेत्रा घृताची च मेनका चोवंशी तथा॥६॥
verses.english: This Supreme-Soul, विष्णु, created the creator ब्रह्म in the days of yore. And that very same Prime-Person, विष्णु, created all the प्रजापति-s at the outset of eras, who on assuming various forms, also with their own forms – as in the case of कश्यप-प्रजापति – in turn created many most excellent beings - पिपीलिकादि ब्रह्म पर्यन्तम् - that are generally termed as the kith and kin of the creator ब्रह्म... and ब्रह्म, euphemistically the वेद-s, have become manifold and everlasting owing to these great beings, प्रजापति-s... as such, विष्णु of amazing deeds has bee eulogised in all the worlds... hence, you too may now hear from me about that विष्णु worthy of those eulogies...

verses.sanskrit: एताः सहस्रशश्चान्या नृत्यगीतविशारदाः। उपतिष्ठन्ति राजानं हिरण्यकशिपुं तदा॥७॥
verses.english: There occured a battle between gods and demons in कृत era after the elimination a demon called वृत्र-असुर... this is battle of gods is with a demon called तारक-असुर whose battling skills are well known in all the three worlds... in that battle the दानवा-s, prideful of their warring ability, have started to trounce the hosts of gods, together with यक्षा-स्, उरगा-स्, and राक्षसा-स्॥। then these defeated warriors, gods and others, had to take to their heels when being battered, and when they lacked counter-assault weapons, and they mentally sought refuge of the omni-protector, विष्णु॥।

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुस्तत्र विचित्राभरणाम्बरः। स्त्रीसहस्नैः परिवृतस्तस्थौ ज्वलितकुण्डलः॥८॥
verses.english: In the meantime, clouds rumbled dreadfully, collided sonorously, showered embers fiercely, covered the sky together with its sun, moon and planets murkily, and pitched a host of flashing lightning punishingly, while the cosmic winds like आवाह, प्रवाह and the like, started to blow gustily and counter-gustily... all this, as it were, bechanced by the trickery of demons... With the downpour of flaming water and flashing lightning, which are of a piece with the thunderbolts of इन्द्र in their dash and blaze there ensued mayhem in the sky, as if whole sky is put to blaze... Thousands of sky-rocketing aerolites have been catapulted repeatedly, and the divine aircrafts of celestials see-sawed as aeronomy has failed... What scare that looms large on the people at the universal destruction chancing at the end of an era – महा-प्रलयम् – that has loomed now on their psyche on seeing similar foretokens now happening on sky... Cast into darkness everything is ill-lit... nothing is recognizable... deluged in the torrents of darkness the ten cardinal points became fuzzy... It is already like अमवास्य-निशि, the tenebrosity of no-moon-night, further veiled by demon-simulated tenebrous clouds, ergo the sun is under a murky veil, ergo the sky is unlit, and ergo life is standstilled...

verses.sanskrit: तत्रासीनं महाबाहुं हिरण्यकशिपुं प्रभुम्। उपासन्ति दितेः पुत्राः सर्वे लब्धवराः पुरा॥९॥
verses.english: श्रीहरि caught those demon-simulated streams of darkness together with gloominess in the bowl of his two palms and annulled it... he then started to reveal his hallowed physique... Let us dwell upon his – दिव्य मन्गल विग्रहम् – hallowed physiognomic features, for a while...

verses.sanskrit: बर्लिर्वैरोचनस्तत्र नरकः पृथिवीजयः। प्राह्रदो विप्रचित्तिश्च गविष्ठश्च महासुरः॥१०॥
अहन्ता क्रोधहन्ता च सुमनाः सुमतिः खरः। घटोदरो महापार्श्वः कथनः पिठरस्तथा॥११॥
verses.english: His दिव्य मन्गल विग्रहम् – hallowed configuration – is simulative of mountainous water-bearing black-cloud, or monolithic mascara, with pitch-black hairdo...

verses.sanskrit: विश्वरूपश्च रूपश्च विरूपश्च महाद्युतिः। दशग्रीवश्च वाली च मेघवासा महारवः॥१२॥
verses.english: Clad in brilliant silks of ochry yellow, adorned with superfine golden ornaments on his smokily blue-black body, he rose up like the fulmination at the end of an era...

verses.sanskrit: कटाभो विकटाभश्च संह्रादश्चेन्द्रतापनः। दैत्यदानवसङ्घाश्च सर्वे ज्वलितकुण्डलाः॥१३॥
verses.english: Brawny shoulders are now belying a black-cloud with a flight of heronry at their fringes, since he is now stretching an octad of his arms, 4*2– अष्ठ भुज – around those shoulders...

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रग्विणो वाग्मिनः सर्वे सर्वे सुचरितव्रताः। सर्वे लब्धवराः शूराः सर्वे विगतमृत्यवः॥१४॥
verses.english: Clasping eight weapons in eight fists he glistened like an unswerving lofty mountaintop mounted on a skyscape florid with fused sunrays and moonbeams...

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च बहवो हिरण्यकशिपुं प्रभुम्। उपासन्ते महात्मानं सर्वे दिव्यपरिच्छदाः॥१५॥
verses.english: Now, wielding his sword called नन्दक in one hand that rejoices to hold it; in another similar hand holding arrows that are ready to spew demonvenom; another hand holding an upraised demonplough, power of which will be amazing; three more hands handling a conch called पान्च-जन्यम्, a disc called सुदर्शनम्, and a mace called कौमोदकि; yet another handling a bow called शारङ्गम्; while the eighth remained free because it is an – अभय हस्त – a shelter-giving-hand, there stood a mountain called विष्णु, like a sweltering tree - श्र-वृक्शम्, where the base of that mountain or that of the fuming tree is nothing but mercy...

verses.sanskrit: विमानैर्विविधैरयैम्राजर्भ्रानैरिवार्चिभिः। स्रग्विणो भूषणधरा यान्ति चायान्ति हेलया॥१६॥
verses.english: Now, he seemed to be encharioted in a divine cosmic-chariot – भुवन-रूप-स्यन्दनम् - yoked with green horses; pennant carrying सुपर्ण, Divine-Eagle’s, monogram; sun and moon as its two beautiful wheels; Mt. मन्दर as its axle; the thousand-headed serpent अनन्त as its reins; Mt. मेरु as its chassis-to-yoke longbeam; sprayey with starlets and festooned with stars and planets; and gods who now stand defeated by demons have seen such a विष्णु in firmament, who is the assurer of safety...

verses.sanskrit: विचित्राभरणोपेता विचित्रवसनास्तथा। विचित्रशस्त्रकवचा विचित्रध्वजवाहनाः॥१७॥
verses.english: Then the gods headed by इन्द्र reverently enfolding their palms hailed him and sought refuge with the lord विष्णु to whom all resort for shelter...

verses.sanskrit: महेन्द्रचापसङ्काशैर्विचित्रैरङ्गदैवरैः। भूषिताङ्गा दितेः पुत्रास्तमुपासन्ति नित्यशः॥१८॥
verses.english: On listening to the pleas of gods विष्णु made up his mind to eliminate all the demons in a great encounter, and then that foremost one among gods, विष्णु, still remaining on the sky promised to the celestials, saying:

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां सभायां दिव्यायामसुराः पर्वतोपमाः। हिरण्यमुकुटाः सर्वे दिवाकरसमप्रभाः॥१९॥
verses.english: Great sages shorn of grief resonantly chanted Vedic hymns, while the Ritual-fire consumed palatable oblations in Vedic rituals...

verses.sanskrit: कनकमणिविचित्रवेदिकायामुपहितरत्नसहस्रवीथिकायाम्। स ददर्श मृगाधिपः सभायां सुरुचिरदन्तगवाक्षसंवृतायाम्॥२०॥
verses.english: श्रीहरि caught those demon-simulated streams of darkness together with gloominess in the bowl of his two palms and annulled it... he then started to reveal his hallowed physique... Let us dwell upon his – दिव्य मन्गल विग्रहम् – hallowed physiognomic features, for a while...

verses.sanskrit: कनकविमलहारभूषिताङ्गं दितितनयं स मृगाधिपो ददर्श। दिनकरकरप्रभं ज्वलन्तमसुरसहस्रगणैर्निषेव्यमाणम्॥२१॥
verses.english: His दिव्य मन्गल विग्रहम् – hallowed configuration – is simulative of mountainous water-bearing black-cloud, or monolithic mascara, with pitch-black hairdo...
